chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Ahmad narrated to me from his father from Muhammad ibn Ahmad from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ibn Sinan from Hammad ibn Uthman from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Applying antimony (kohl) promotes hair growth, dries up tears, thickens saliva, and clears the eyesight.

key_terms.الْكُحْلُ: Antimony or kohl, a traditional cosmetic and medicinal powder applied to the eyes

ai.seo_question: What are the physical benefits of applying kohl according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Thawab al-A'mal*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) elucidates the prophetic tradition of using kohl (antimony) not merely for adornment but as a therapeutic agent with four distinct physiological benefits: promoting eyelash growth, drying excessive tears, thickening saliva to aid digestion, and clarifying vision. This hadith underscores the Shia emphasis on integrating physical health with spiritual practice, reflecting the Imam's holistic view of the human body as a trust (amanah) to be maintained through Sunnah-based remedies.
